critique.evidence: The screen has a clear, demo-worthy visual thesis: a signed transaction chain flows into a widening cyan/red intent-versus-outcome divergence, while four green VERIFIED checks are sharply contrasted with a red SEMANTIC INVARIANT failure. The oversized editorial headline reinforces that same paradox, making the concept more memorable than a routine dashboard. The dark grid, monospace labels, and status pills are somewhat familiar cyber-dashboard styling, and the chain becomes tiny and partly clipped on mobile, limiting a higher score.
critique.fix: Make the intent-to-outcome split the dominant responsive hero visualization, with readable mobile nodes and a more explicit visual bridge from the green verified checks to the red semantic failure; reduce reliance on familiar cyber-dashboard ornament.
